headline: GOLD SMASHES $4,600 — BEST WEEKLY GAIN OF 2026 AT +5.6%; WALL STREET NOW BEREFT OF BEARS WITH PCE DATA NEXT
snippet: Gold broke decisively above $4,600 per ounce on August 21, 2026 — its highest level since mid-May — posting its strongest weekly gain of 2026 at 5.6%. New York gold futures hit an intraday high of $4,636.30, up 1.4% on the session. Kitco's weekly Wall Street/Main Street survey showed zero bearish respondents for the first time this cycle, with the consensus pointing toward PCE inflation data as the next catalyst: a soft PCE print could accelerate the move toward $4,700 and cement the rate-hike odds collapse from 50% to 31% already priced by fed funds futures. The US Dollar Index hit a three-month low and the Treasury's surprise expansion of longer-dated debt purchases pushed bond yields lower, reinforcing the gold bid.

headline: UBS RAISES GOLD FORECAST, TARGETS NEW RECORD HIGHS — $40T US DEBT AND DOLLAR COLLAPSE EXTEND BULL CASE HORIZON
snippet: UBS commodity strategists raised their gold price forecast on August 21, 2026, extending the timeline for new record highs and lifting their price target to $5,400 per ounce by end-September 2027. The revision was driven by three structural developments: the US Dollar Index breaking to multi-month lows, the US national debt crossing $40 trillion while the Treasury unexpectedly expanded long-dated bond purchases, and the Federal Reserve's rate-hike path becoming increasingly constrained by consecutive soft CPI, PPI, and jobs prints. UBS had previously lowered its outlook to $5,500 in May 2026 before this upward revision; gold at $4,600+ has already validated their earlier bullish view.

headline: ALKANE RESOURCES FY26: NET PROFIT SURGES 590% TO A$228.7M — GOLD PRODUCTION UP 140%, CASH NEARLY 7X TO $439M AFTER MANDALAY MERGER
snippet: Alkane Resources Ltd. (ASX: ALK; TSX: ALK) reported record FY26 results on August 21, 2026, following its transformative merger with Mandalay Resources: net profit after tax surged 590% to A$228.7 million on revenue of A$935.8 million, itself up 257% year-over-year. Gold equivalent production jumped 140% to a record 168,337 ounces at an average realised gold price of A$5,664 per ounce, while cash and bullion on hand grew from A$60.3 million to A$438.9 million. The company declared its maiden fully-franked final dividend of two cents per share and approved an on-market share buy-back — signalling the board's confidence that the high gold price environment is durable. The results exemplify the earnings leverage available to mid-tier gold producers in the current gold price cycle.

headline: WESTHAVEN GOLD 10.04m AT 12.18 g/t AU + 103 g/t AG — SHOVELNOSE SOUTH ZONE EXTENDS BELOW THE PEA'S DEEPEST PLANNED STOPES
snippet: Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSXV: WHN) released the fifth batch of assay results from its 35,000-metre resource infill program at the Shovelnose Gold Property in southern British Columbia on August 20, 2026. Drill hole SNR26-117 returned 10.04 metres grading 12.18 g/t Au and 103 g/t Ag, intersecting high-grade gold-silver mineralization below the deepest mining stopes proposed in the company's 2025 preliminary economic assessment — meaning the resource is growing downward beyond what the PEA modelled. SNR26-110 added 37.34 metres at 6.24 g/t Au and 55 g/t Ag, confirming thick, consistent grades at the southeastern deposit margin. The 2026 field program continues through mid-December with both infill and exploration drilling.

headline: TROILUS DRILLS 8.84 g/t AUEQ OVER 4.8m AT Z87 — GOLD-COPPER MINERALIZATION CONFIRMED 400m BEYOND CURRENT QUEBEC PIT SHELL
snippet: Troilus Mining Corp. (TSX: TLG; OTCQX: CHXMF) announced August 20, 2026 assay results from five re-entered and extended drill holes at the Z87 zone of the Troilus gold-copper project in north-central Quebec: the best hole returned 8.84 g/t AuEq (7.02 g/t Au, 21.63 g/t Ag, 1.03% Cu) over 4.8 metres including a 23.58 g/t AuEq core over 1 metre, starting at 859 metres downhole. Critically, all five holes intersected mineralization at least 400 metres beyond the existing resource pit shell — validating Z87 as a material expansion target. The company drilled by re-entering historical holes at depth to test the high-grade interpreted core, confirming grade continuity at depth and opening a vector for a significant resource addition.

headline: LAKE VICTORIA GOLD BREAKS GROUND IN TANZANIA — IMWELO PROJECT STARTS PHASE 1 EARTHWORKS BETWEEN NORTH MARA AND BULYANHULU
snippet: Lake Victoria Gold Corp. announced August 21, 2026 that its fully-permitted Imwelo Gold Project in Tanzania has entered physical construction, with Phase 1 earthworks commenced July 28, 2026 and a Phase 3 land programme beginning August 1. The project sits between two of Tanzania's largest operating gold mines — Barrick's North Mara and AngloGold's Bulyanhulu — in a proven, high-grade belt. The move into construction marks the transition from exploration to development and represents the first physical infrastructure milestone for the company. No production timeline or capital cost summary was disclosed in the announcement.

headline: PACIFICA SILVER SECURES 491 NEW DRILL PADS, EXPANDS CLAUDIA PROGRAM TO 30,000m — FOURTH RIG ARRIVING END OF AUGUST
snippet: Pacifica Silver Corp. (CSE: PSIL) announced August 20, 2026 that SEMARNAT — Mexico's Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources — has issued permits for 491 additional drill pad sites at the 100%-owned Claudia Silver-Gold Project in the El Papantón Mining District, Durango State. The company is expanding its Phase II drill program from its previous scope to a fully funded 30,000-metre total, deploying a fourth diamond drill rig to site by end of August 2026. As of August 19, 18,258 metres across 79 holes had already been completed, with the expanded program continuing through end-2026. The new permits significantly expand target access across the Claudia property.

headline: PATAGONIA GOLD CALCATREU ORDERED SUSPENDED BY ARGENTINA LABOUR AUTHORITY — COMPANY COOPERATING TO RESTORE OPERATIONS
snippet: Patagonia Gold Corp. disclosed August 21, 2026 that on August 19 the Río Negro Secretariat of Labour ordered the preventive, partial and temporary suspension of certain operational activities at the company's Calcatreu Gold Project in Rio Negro Province, Argentina, following a site inspection. The scope of the order is being assessed; essential maintenance, health and safety activities continue. Calcatreu is a US$250 million-scale permitted development project; the suspension highlights the political and regulatory risk that remains embedded in Argentine mining assets even after permitting milestones are achieved. Patagonia says it is cooperating fully with provincial authorities to resume normal operations.

headline: GOLD MID-TIERS Q2'26: RECORD-LOW AISC/GOLD RATIO OF 28.8% — GDXJ TOP 25 UNIT PROFITS HIT $2,850/OZ, UP 49% YOY
snippet: Adam Hamilton's August 2026 analysis of GDXJ top 25 mid-tier gold miners' Q2 2026 fundamentals shows the sector achieving record operating margins: the ratio of average all-in sustaining costs to the gold price hit a record-low 28.8% in Q2 — meaning the mid-tiers kept 71.2 cents of every dollar of gold they sold. Implied unit profits of $2,850 per ounce represent a 49% year-over-year increase from Q2 2025, with full-year 2026 AISC guidance midpoints averaging $1,727 per ounce against a gold price that has averaged above $4,500. The analysis notes many mid-tiers are guiding for higher back-half output that will compress AISCs further — suggesting Q3 and Q4 profits may exceed Q2 levels if gold stays above $4,500.

headline: MP MATERIALS EXTENDS POST-Q2 RALLY AS WALL STREET BACKS RARE EARTH THESIS — MORGAN STANLEY RAISES TARGET TO $73
snippet: MP Materials Corp. (NYSE: MP) extended its post-earnings rally on August 21, 2026, rising approximately 8% as Wall Street responded to the company's Q2 results — which showed revenue up 89% year-over-year to $108.5 million — with broad endorsements. Morgan Stanley lifted its price target to $73 per share (Overweight), citing NdPr output ramp, magnet facility expansion toward the 10X magnet target, and a new long-term gadolinium supply deal with a US aerospace and defence customer. Deutsche Bank and JPMorgan maintained Buy/Overweight stances, trimming targets modestly but holding conviction on the domestic rare earth supply chain thesis. USA Rare Earth (USAR) and NioCorp also gained on the broad sector bid.

headline: COPPER TESTS $6.50 PIVOT: PENDING US TARIFF CALL, DRC EXPORT BAN, AND CODELCO'S 2-YEAR EL TENIENTE SETBACK ALL IN PLAY
snippet: Copper futures pulled back to around $6.50 per pound this week after setting a fresh all-time record near $6.90 on August 6, 2026, as traders locked in profits and awaited the pending US Commerce Department tariff decision — still not issued despite an original June deadline. Three structural supply stories remain in play: the DRC banned exports of copper and cobalt concentrates effective June 29 (announced August 6), Codelco suspended the Andes Norte expansion at El Teniente — the world's largest underground copper mine — after identifying deep seismic risks with a potential two-year timeline impact, and more than 200,000 tonnes of copper arrived at US ports in July alone as importers front-ran tariffs. The $6.50 level is being watched as support before any renewed attempt on the record.
